item.title: Georgia: ¿por qué el país se aleja de la Unión Europea?

item.description: US President Donald Trump has floated the idea of a trilateral summit with China and Russia to broker an end to the Iran war, with his administration under pressure to deliver a breakthrough following the US midterm elections, according to analysts. item.title: 'Crumbs': French PM's 1.6% minimum wage increase fails to placate unions
item.description: French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu announced on Monday that a planned 1.6% increase in the minimum wage would be brought forward from January to December after holding talks with trade unions and business leaders over the cost-of-living crisis that has fuelled weeks of unrest across France. The increase fell well short of the demands of unions, which have called for fresh protests in the coming days. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Iran 'has mistaken perception' of US midterm result, expert says
item.description: A leading commentator on Iran says the country sees the results of the US midterm elections as giving them a golden opportunity for a sweet deal. Paymon Azmoudeh from Forward Global was speaking amid conflicting statements from the key players about whether there will be further US military action in Iran. President Donald Trump says that renewed strikes on Iran are "highly unlikely" if talks progress. However, Iran's foreign minister says the midterms have brought a ⁠pause to mediators' work. Fuente: France 24 - English.
